questions.prompt: Which best describes metrics compared with logs in Azure Monitor?

options.text: Metrics are numeric, near-real-time time-series values
Metrics are long text records queried with KQL
Metrics can only be viewed once per day
Metrics are the same thing as alerts

questions.explanation: Metrics are lightweight, numeric, near-real-time time-series values (great for dashboards and quick alerts). Logs are richer, structured records stored in Log Analytics and queried with KQL.

questions.prompt: Which statements about Azure Monitor are true? Select all that apply.

options.text: Application Insights provides application performance monitoring
Logs are stored in a Log Analytics workspace and queried with KQL
An alert rule can use an action group to notify or automate a response
Creating many noisy, low-value alerts is a best practice

questions.explanation: App Insights is APM; logs live in Log Analytics (KQL); alerts trigger action groups. Over-alerting causes alert fatigue — alert only on actionable conditions.

questions.prompt: The query language used to analyze logs in a Log Analytics workspace is abbreviated ____.
questions.explanation: KQL (Kusto Query Language) is a pipe-based language used to query logs, power log-based alerts, and build workbooks.

questions.prompt: Order what happens when a monitored condition is breached.

items.text: A signal crosses the alert condition
People are notified or a response is automated

questions.explanation: A signal breaches the condition, the alert rule fires, its action group runs, and it notifies people or automates a response.

questions.prompt: Match each monitoring concept to its meaning.

pairs.right: The umbrella platform for telemetry and alerting
Where logs are stored and queried with KQL

questions.explanation: Azure Monitor is the umbrella; metrics are numeric; Log Analytics stores logs (KQL); App Insights is APM.
